scripts.lint: cd .. && oxlint -c web/.oxlintrc.json web/src web/scripts web/tests web/vite.config.ts web/playwright.config.ts
scripts.format: cd .. && oxfmt -c web/.oxfmtrc.json web/src web/scripts web/tests web/fixtures web/vite.config.ts web/playwright.config.ts --write
scripts.format:check: cd .. && oxfmt -c web/.oxfmtrc.json web/src web/scripts web/tests web/fixtures web/vite.config.ts web/playwright.config.ts --check
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun run build:harness && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:update: bun run build && bun run build:harness && playwright test --update-snapshots
